title: 2.1.14 Guard with a Truthy Check
description: Write an if statement that tests a variable directly, relying on truthy/falsy conversion. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Declare a string variable
steps.instructions: Create a variable called searchTerm and set it to an empty string "".

steps.title: Test it directly
steps.instructions: Write an if statement whose condition is just searchTerm (no comparison operator). Log a message for when it's truthy, and add an else that logs a message for when it's falsy.
